description:
#1 Dermatologist recommended kit to reduce strawberry skin. It is enriched with actives like Salicylic Acid & Lactic Acid.🌟

Our Strawberry Skin Exfoliation Kit contains:

1% Salicylic Acid Body Wash: Exfoliates and removes dead skin cells around and on top of ingrown hair

10% AHA Body Scrub: It has 10% Lactic Acid which helps to provide deep exfoliation and boost cell turnover

✅ Follow routine for atleast 3 months for best results. 

 📱Download the Be Bodywise app & save upto 30% using the app wallet!

Step 1: Apply adequate amount of bodywash on wet skin.
Step 2: Post bodywash, take some scrub and massage into skin using gentle, circular motions.
 

Note: ✅ Use the bodywash daily, and scrub 2 times a week for atleast 3 months for best results🗓️.

faqs.question: Can I use 10% AHA Body Scrub every day?
faqs.answer: No, we recommend using this body scrub for all skin types once-twice a week

faqs.question: How much time will it take to see results?
faqs.answer: You will start noticing visible improvement gradually. Use for 3 months for best results.
